content.title: 形式主语 it 速查(It is + adj./n. + to do / that 从句)
content.intro: 当真正的主语是不定式、that 从句或 -ing 时,英语习惯把它放到句末,主语位置用 it 占位,这个 it 就叫'形式主语'。判断口诀:句首主语位置是空的、后面跟着 to do 或 that 从句,就填 it。

rows: It is vital not to take any chances.(真正主语 = 不定式)
It is + adj. + that 从句
It is true that disease respects no borders.(真正主语 = that 从句)
It is + n. + that 从句
It is a pity that some patients could not be saved.
It takes + 时间/精力 + to do
It takes courage to break boundaries.
It seems that the world is getting smaller.
It is no use worrying about culture shock.

specialRules.rule: 主语位置只能用 it,不能用 that/this/there
specialRules.mark: It is important to … √ / That is important to … ×

specialRules.rule: that 从句、不定式都可后置;-ing 多用于 It is no use/good doing
It is + adj. + of sb to do(评价人) vs for sb to do(说明难易)
specialRules.mark: It is kind of you to help / It is hard for me to decide

specialRules.rule: there seems/happens 后只能接 to be,不接 that 从句
specialRules.mark: It seems that… √ / There seems that… ×

why: 英语句子'头轻脚重',不喜欢主语太长。把长长的不定式或从句放到句末,用 it 占住主语位置,句子更顺、重点更清楚。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/改错高频:主语位置空着、后接 to do 或 that 从句 → 填 it。
区分形式主语 it 与形式宾语 it(find/think/make it + adj. + to do);区分 it 与 there be。

examVsReal.exam: It is important to remember this.(考试规范)
examVsReal.note: 考试爱用完整形式主语句;口语常把重点前移、再补一句评价。

examVsReal.exam: It is no use worrying.(考试)
examVsReal.note: 口语常用 No point / There's no point doing 表达同样意思。
